document_metadata.analysis_scope: Full project repository audit encompassing backend (FastAPI), frontend (React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Capacitor), research pipeline (PyTorch + wav2vec2 + benchmark scripts), test suites, configuration, and documentation.
limitations: Hardware-dependent benchmarks (such as GPU vs CPU inference latency) were evaluated in a CPU-only environment.

The bundled sample audio files in research/data/asvspoof_sample and research/data/ground_truth_benchmark are lightweight subsets (10 to 40 clips) designed for test execution, CI verification, and UI demonstrations rather than training production-scale deepfake detectors.
Subprocess MP3 encoding in AudioTransformer.mp3_compress depends on system FFmpeg availability; in environments lacking FFmpeg, a fallback Gaussian quantization noise simulation is invoked.

project_overview.name: EchoProof AI
project_overview.tagline: Hear the Truth Behind Every Voice — Research-Grade Speech Deepfake Detection & Acoustic Robustness Laboratory
project_overview.description: EchoProof AI is an academic and forensic speech deepfake detection system engineered to investigate whether modern audio classifiers remain resilient under real-world telephone bandpass filtering, environmental noise, and lossy compression. It couples pretrained self-supervised representations (wav2vec 2.0) with an 11-condition acoustic perturbation laboratory, speaker-disjoint validation protocols, and selective prediction (risk-coverage trade-offs with AURC).
project_overview.problem_statement: Rapid advances in neural vocoding, text-to-speech (TTS), and voice conversion (VC) architectures (e.g., FastSpeech 2, VITS, HiFi-GAN, diffusion models) allow adversaries to generate hyper-realistic cloned human speech. Contemporary detectors trained on pristine studio audio (such as ASVspoof 2019) fail catastrophically when deployed in real-world scenarios due to: 1) Unseen generator vulnerability; 2) Channel brittleness under telephone bandwidth (8 kHz) or lossy codecs (MP3); and 3) Overconfident uncalibrated softmax predictions that generate false accusations in forensic contexts.
project_overview.proposed_solution: EchoProof AI provides an end-to-end framework that evaluates self-supervised speech representations (wav2vec 2.0 with Attentive Statistical Pooling), tests model degradation systematically across 11 physical/codec distortions, enforces strict speaker-disjoint evaluation to eliminate biometric data leakage, introduces selective abstention (AURC) to cut classification risk by over 60%, and delivers an interactive full-stack interface with live audio recording, waveform/spectrogram rendering, and forensic report export.
primary_objectives: Provide accessible, real-time speech deepfake inference using fine-tuned wav2vec 2.0 models.
Empirically quantify detector performance degradation under controlled acoustic perturbations (noise, downsampling, filtering, codecs, clipping).
Eliminate biometric data leakage in evaluation splits via strict speaker-disjoint partitioning.
Implement selective prediction and risk-coverage estimation (AURC) to allow model abstention on ambiguous audio.
Support academic dissemination with reproducible benchmark pipelines generating Markdown and LaTeX tables.
Deliver a modern, responsive web application (React 19) and installable mobile container (Capacitor Android).
target_users: Academic examiners and evaluators during capstone, thesis, and viva defense.
Forensic audio examiners investigating disputed speech recordings or fraudulent calls.
Cybersecurity and fraud prevention engineers protecting voice biometric systems.
Speech and machine learning researchers benchmarking anti-spoofing generalization.
use_cases: Forensic Speech Verification: Uploading a suspicious voice recording, receiving chunk-level anomaly scores, and exporting an audit dossier.
Acoustic Channel Stress-Testing: Evaluating how a voice classifier behaves when subjected to PSTN telephony (8 kHz) or lossy MP3 compression.
Academic Research Benchmarking: Running evaluation experiments over labeled manifests to compute EER, AUC-ROC, and bootstrap confidence intervals.
Interactive Viva / Demo Walkthrough: Live microphone recording with client-side PCM encoding, real-time waveform visualization, and preset sample testing.
key_features: Wav2Vec2 Inference Adapter with explicit semantic label discovery (resolving {0: fake, 1: real} vs {0: bonafide, 1: spoof}).
Attentive Statistical Pooling (ASP) network architecture for capturing localized temporal vocoder artifacts.
4-second sliding window chunking with mean aggregation and duration thresholding.
Acoustic Robustness Suite providing 11 physical and channel distortions (Gaussian noise, G.711/G.722, reverb, codecs, clipping, packet loss).
Speaker-Disjoint Dataset Partitioning to prevent speaker memorization and biometric leakage.
Selective Classification (AURC) computing risk-coverage curves and safe abstention thresholds.
Resilient Fallback Mode (AcousticSpectralDetector) that safely abstains with 'Uncertain' when weights fail to load, rejecting unverified heuristics.
Client-side 16-bit PCM WAV microphone recorder bypassing browser WebM encoding incompatibilities.
Interactive Mel-Spectrogram and Waveform Envelope visualization.
Full PWA support with auto-updating service worker and Capacitor configuration for Android native execution.
project_overview.value_proposition: Unlike black-box classifiers that output naive binary predictions, EchoProof AI equips researchers and forensic analysts with cross-channel stability metrics, selective abstention capabilities, and leak-free validation protocols to verify when a deepfake detection verdict can actually be trusted.
project_overview.project_type: Full-stack Machine Learning Web Application & Research Framework

functional_requirements: Accept audio uploads in .wav, .mp3, .flac, .m4a, .ogg, and .opus formats up to 25 MB in size.
Enforce audio duration boundaries between 0.5 seconds and 300 seconds.
Perform channel downmixing to mono and polyphase resampling to 16,000 Hz.
Reject silent or corrupt audio where RMS energy is less than 1e-6.
Partition audio longer than 4.0 seconds into sliding 4.0-second windows with trailing chunk thresholding.
Score audio chunks using wav2vec 2.0 and aggregate chunk scores into a final primary spoof score.
Map scores into three categorical research verdicts: LIKELY_GENUINE (score <= 0.35), LIKELY_SYNTHETIC (score >= 0.65), and UNCERTAIN (0.35 < score < 0.65).
Execute robustness perturbation sweeps on demand and report score standard deviation, maximum score delta, and verdict flips.
Execute asynchronous dataset evaluation jobs with progress callbacks and in-memory status tracking.
Calculate EER, AUC-ROC, Accuracy, F1-Score, Precision, Recall, Confusion Matrix, and 95% Bootstrap CIs over 1,000 resamples.
Export evaluation predictions to CSV and forensic analysis dossiers to JSON.
non_functional_requirements: Sub-second inference response time for standard 4-second audio clips on modern CPU hardware.
Deterministic and reproducible evaluation runs via explicit random seeding (default seed 42).
Safe failure and graceful degradation: neutral abstention with explicit warnings if model weights fail to load.
Zero biometric data leakage: strict speaker disjointness enforced between validation and test splits.
High visual fidelity: dark-mode glassmorphic interface with CSS tokens and accessible contrast ratios.
Cross-platform compatibility: responsive desktop web, installable PWA, and Capacitor Android container.
technical_constraints: Target sample rate fixed at 16,000 Hz to match wav2vec 2.0 acoustic pretraining.
In-memory job management bounded to a maximum of 100 entries to prevent memory exhaustion.
Maximum concurrent asynchronous jobs limited to 3 (configurable via ECHOPROOF_MAX_JOBS).
Python 3.10+ required for backend typing and scikit-learn/scipy compatibility (verified on Python 3.12).
Node.js 20+ required for modern Vite bundler and React 19 compilation.
business_rules: Softmax probabilities are uncalibrated model scores and must never be represented as absolute legal proof of speech falsification.
When model weights cannot load, the system MUST abstain with an UNCERTAIN verdict; hand-crafted spectral heuristics must never produce an authentic verdict.
Decision thresholds must be calibrated on a speaker-disjoint validation split before making academic or deployment accuracy claims.
The sample clips provided in the repository are strictly for UI demonstration and test verification; production training requires external public corpora (SpeechFake, ASVspoof).
assumptions: Incoming audio contains human vocal speech or synthetic vocal speech in the audible range.
Client browser supports Web Audio API (AudioContext) for live microphone recording.
Local or server filesystem permits temporary audio writing and automated deletion.
requirements_not_verified: Native Android biometric audio capture in production hardware without user microphone permission prompt.
FFmpeg MP3 compression behavior in minimal Linux containers lacking the ffmpeg binary (falls back to simulated quantization noise).

communication_patterns: Client to Backend: HTTP REST requests (JSON bodies and multipart/form-data audio file uploads).
Asynchronous Job Coordination: Client POST to start evaluation receives job_id; client periodically polls GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id} until status is completed.
Vite Proxy: Frontend development server proxies /api requests to http://localhost:8000 to prevent local CORS issues.
Internal Backend Modules: Direct asynchronous and synchronous Python function calls.
data_flow: 1. User drops audio file or records microphone speech in AnalyzePage.
3. Route handler validates file size and extension, saves temporary audio file in backend/temp_audio.
4. AudioProcessor loads audio with soundfile/torchaudio, downmixes to mono, and checks RMS energy >= 1e-6.
5. AudioProcessor resamples audio to 16,000 Hz and segments into 4.0-second chunk windows.
6. AudioProcessor generates 800 downsampled waveform points and a Mel-spectrogram matrix for frontend rendering.
7. Detector passes each audio chunk through wav2vec 2.0 to obtain softmax probabilities for bonafide and spoof.
8. Chunk scores are averaged via arithmetic mean; thresholds are applied to determine LIKELY_GENUINE, LIKELY_SYNTHETIC, or UNCERTAIN.
9. AnalysisResult is serialized to JSON and returned to client; temporary audio file is deleted in finally block.
10. Client renders animated verdict badge, score bar, interactive waveform, and forensic details.
request_lifecycle: Client Request -> FastAPI middleware (CORS) -> Router dispatch -> Endpoint function -> Temp audio write -> Validation & AudioProcessor -> Detector inference -> Postprocessing & Metrics -> Temp audio cleanup -> JSON response serialization -> Client state update.
background_jobs: Dataset evaluation initiated via POST /api/v1/evaluation/run runs asynchronously via FastAPI BackgroundTasks.
Job state is registered in JobManager with status 'pending' and updated to 'processing', updating numeric progress (0.0 to 1.0) and messages.
Client polls GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id} every 1.5 seconds until status reaches 'completed' or 'failed'.
Upon completion, evaluation results and predictions.csv are serialized to research/results/{job_id}/ on disk.
external_integrations: Hugging Face Transformers Model Hub: Pretrained model weights download (MelodyMachine/Deepfake-audio-detection-V2 and facebook/wav2vec2-base).
System FFmpeg binary: Invoked via subprocess by AudioTransformer for MP3 compression stress testing.

architecture_decisions.decision: Use fine-tuned wav2vec 2.0 self-supervised representations over handcrafted MFCCs + CNNs.
architecture_decisions.reason: Handcrafted MFCCs discard phase information and fine temporal dynamics. Pretrained wav2vec 2.0 captures rich acoustic contextual embeddings that expose subtle vocoder artifacts and synthetic harmonic discontinuities.

architecture_decisions.decision: Enforce explicit semantic label discovery rather than hardcoding class indices.
architecture_decisions.reason: Different model training pipelines sort classes differently (e.g. ASVspoof uses 0:bonafide, 1:spoof, whereas Hugging Face AudioFolder sorts alphabetically into 0:fake, 1:real). Hardcoding index 1 as synthetic caused complete inverted predictions.

architecture_decisions.decision: Neutral abstention (Uncertain verdict) when model weights fail to load, refusing spectral heuristic authenticity verdicts.
architecture_decisions.reason: Handwritten spectral heuristics (spectral centroid, high-frequency energy ratio) cannot reliably distinguish authentic human voice from modern neural speech. Reporting a heuristic result as 'Genuine' is dangerous in forensic contexts.
alternatives: Using heuristic detector as full fallback verdict provider

architecture_decisions.decision: Strict speaker-disjoint dataset splitting during validation and threshold tuning.
architecture_decisions.reason: Random sample-level splitting allows audio from the same speaker to appear in both training and test sets, enabling models to memorize speaker identities (biometric leakage) rather than detecting spoofing artifacts.

architecture_decisions.decision: Encode microphone audio directly to 16-bit PCM WAV in the browser using Web Audio API.
architecture_decisions.reason: Standard browser MediaRecorder records in WebM/Opus format, which frequently fails client-side decoding in certain desktop/mobile browsers or causes sample rate header mismatches when decoded server-side.
alternatives: WAV encoding on the server from raw WebM

feature_inventory.name: Single Audio Deepfake Analysis
feature_inventory.description: Upload or record an audio file to determine whether speech is authentic human voice, synthetic deepfake, or uncertain, complete with temporal chunk analysis, waveform envelope, and spectrogram.
user_workflow: User opens Analyze page.
User drags and drops an audio file, selects a preloaded sample, or clicks Record Voice.
User clicks Analyze Recording.
System displays animated progress, followed by a color-coded VerdictBadge (Likely Genuine, Likely Synthetic, or Uncertain).
System renders uncalibrated probability score bar, audio metadata, waveform envelope, and chunk breakdown for audio > 4s.
User can download the complete forensic analysis dossier as a JSON file.
limitations: Audio longer than 4s is aggregated via arithmetic mean across chunks.

feature_inventory.name: Audio Robustness Testing Laboratory
feature_inventory.description: Applies controlled physical and channel perturbations (Gaussian noise, 8 kHz telephony, Butterworth lowpass filtering, volume scaling, MP3 compression) to an audio file and measures score shifts and verdict flips.
user_workflow: User navigates to Robustness Lab page.
User uploads audio or loads preset benchmark sample.
User adjusts noise SNR, resample rate, lowpass cutoff, and gain sliders.
User clicks Run Perturbation Suite.
System displays side-by-side comparison table of original vs transformed scores, score standard deviation, max score delta, and threshold crossings.
validation_and_error_handling: Catches transformation exceptions per perturbation so individual failures do not abort the entire suite.
Returns transformation_succeeded=false with error string if an individual transform fails.
limitations: MP3 compression relies on system FFmpeg; if absent, simulated quantization noise is applied.

feature_inventory.name: Research Dataset Evaluation & Benchmark Dashboard
feature_inventory.description: Evaluates detector performance over labeled dataset manifests with speaker-disjoint partitioning, threshold tuning on validation data, and statistical metrics with bootstrap confidence intervals.
user_workflow: User navigates to Research page.
User specifies dataset manifest path, metadata CSV, and speaker column.
User sets validation split ratio and toggles Speaker-Disjoint Split.
User clicks Run Benchmark Evaluation.
System creates async job, polls progress, and renders EER, AUC-ROC, Accuracy, F1, Confusion Matrix, and ROC curve.
User can inspect past evaluation runs or export predictions CSV.
validation_and_error_handling: Maps heterogeneous label names (bonafide, real, spoof, synthetic).
Warns on duplicate filenames or missing audio files.
limitations: Evaluations run on the backend host; large datasets require sufficient disk space and processing time.

feature_inventory.name: Offline Model Abstention & Fault Tolerance
feature_inventory.description: Graceful degradation when neural model weights cannot load (offline environment, rate limiting, or missing files). System abstains with an UNCERTAIN verdict and explicit warning rather than reporting false authentic results.
user_workflow: Backend starts without network access or model weights.
Wav2Vec2Detector catches loading failure and activates AcousticSpectralDetector fallback.
Inference requests return verdict=UNCERTAIN with warning: 'The speech detector could not load its neural model...'
Frontend renders neutral warning badge without falsely confirming authenticity.
validation_and_error_handling: Returns 503 if backend is completely uninitialized.
Returns 200 with UNCERTAIN and warning if model fails to load.
limitations: Inference cannot detect deepfakes when offline unless weights were previously cached in Hugging Face cache directory or provided as a local checkpoint.

feature_inventory.name: Research Training & Checkpointing Engine
feature_inventory.description: Standalone PyTorch training script featuring Wav2Vec2 backbone with configurable layer freezing, Attentive Statistical Pooling, Focal Loss, acoustic distortion augmentation, and EER-based checkpoint saving.
user_workflow: Researcher prepares train and validation CSV manifests.
Researcher runs python research/train.py --train_csv ... --val_csv ....
Trainer logs loss, validation EER, and AUC-ROC each epoch.
Trainer saves best_model_eer.pt and decision_thresholds.json.
User configures ECHOPROOF_CHECKPOINT in .env to load the trained model into the backend.
validation_and_error_handling: Validates sample rates and audio lengths.
limitations: Requires GPU for training at scale (e.g. XLS-R 300M).

feature_inventory.name: Client-Side PCM WAV Audio Recording
feature_inventory.description: High-fidelity browser microphone audio recording using Web Audio API ScriptProcessorNode to capture uncompressed 16-bit PCM WAV audio, preventing container codec decoding failures.
user_workflow: User clicks Record Voice on Analyze page.
Browser requests microphone permission.
Live recording timer increments.
User clicks Stop Recording.
Script constructs in-memory 44-byte WAV header and PCM samples, creating a Blob File.
File is automatically loaded into the analysis workspace.
limitations: ScriptProcessorNode runs on audio thread; future update could use AudioWorklet.

middleware.name: CORSMiddleware
middleware.configuration: Configured with CORS_ORIGINS allowing localhost:5173, localhost:5174, localhost:3000, credentials=True, all methods and headers.

business_logic: Inference scores represent probability of synthetic voice: P(spoof) = Softmax(logits)[spoof_index].
Decision thresholds categorize speech: P(spoof) <= 0.35 -> LIKELY_GENUINE, P(spoof) >= 0.65 -> LIKELY_SYNTHETIC, otherwise UNCERTAIN.
Audio exceeding 4.0s duration is split into sequential 4.0s chunks; final score is the mean across chunks.
Evaluation requires disjoint speakers between validation and test splits to prevent memorization.
EER is determined by the intersection of False Acceptance Rate (FAR) and False Rejection Rate (FRR) via Brentq optimization.
background_processing: JobManager coordinates progress updates (0.0 to 1.0) and status transitions.
logging_and_error_handling: Standard library logging with INFO level by default.
AudioProcessingError raises HTTP 422 with validation details.
Model failures log stack traces and return HTTP 503 or neutral abstention results.
Temporary audio files are cleaned up in finally blocks.
known_issues: In-memory JobManager state resets when the backend server restarts.
Subprocess MP3 encoding requires system FFmpeg; falls back to simulated noise if missing.

seed_data: Sample ground truth clips in backend/scratch_audio/ground_truth/ and research/data/ground_truth_benchmark/: 5 authentic human speech clips (LibriSpeech flac, LJSpeech wav) and 5 synthetic clips (DeepVoice 3 wav, FastSpeech 2 wav).
transactions_and_consistency: Job state updates protected by single-threaded event loop and asyncio.Semaphore concurrency controls.

authentication_methods: No authentication required; public open-access academic and forensic research workbench.
authorization_model: Public open endpoints; no role-based access control (RBAC).
encryption_mechanisms: Client-side Web Audio API PCM WAV generation; HTTPS supported when deployed behind reverse proxy or Capacitor Android SSL configuration.
secret_management: No secret keys, database passwords, or private tokens exist in the repository.
.env.example contains model IDs and numerical threshold configuration with no sensitive credentials.
input_validation: File size verified against MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_BYTES (25 MB).
Silent audio checked via Root-Mean-Square: RMS = sqrt(mean(waveform^2)) >= 1e-6.
Pydantic schemas validate all JSON payloads.
cors_configuration: Default origins: http://localhost:5173, http://127.0.0.1:5173, http://localhost:5174, http://127.0.0.1:5174, http://localhost:3000.
rate_limiting: Concurrency limited via asyncio.Semaphore(MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS) where default MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS = 3.
file_upload_security: Temporary upload filenames sanitized using alphanumeric filter with length truncated to 50 characters, combined with random UUID hex prefix.
Temporary files stored inside controlled TEMP_DIR (backend/temp_audio), not user-specifiable arbitrary directories.
Cleanup routine verifies target path resides strictly within TEMP_DIR before invoking unlink().
sensitive_data_handling: Uploaded voice audio is considered biometric data; files are ephemeral and deleted from disk upon completion of inference.
identified_vulnerabilities: Unauthenticated evaluation endpoint allows triggering background jobs if backend is exposed directly to the public internet.
Subprocess invocation in AudioTransformer.mp3_compress executes ffmpeg CLI; paths are strictly controlled, but running without sandbox in shared multi-tenant environments requires process isolation.
security_recommendations: Place backend behind a reverse proxy (Nginx / Caddy) with TLS termination and rate limiting if exposing publicly.
Add API key authentication middleware (e.g. FastAPI Security HTTPBearer) for multi-user production deployments.

ai_ml_and_nlp.problem_definition: Binary audio classification estimating posterior probability P(synthetic | x) to detect machine-generated speech (TTS, VC, neural vocoding) vs genuine human voice.

models.name: MelodyMachine/Deepfake-audio-detection-V2 (Default Active Model)
models.architecture: 12-layer transformer encoder, 768 hidden dimension, 8 attention heads, ~94M parameters, linear classification head (768 -> 2).
models.pretraining: Self-supervised masked audio modeling on LibriSpeech (facebook/wav2vec2-base), fine-tuned on ASVspoof 2019 LA.

models.name: EchoProofClassifier (Custom Research Architecture)
models.architecture: facebook/wav2vec2-base or facebook/wav2vec2-xls-r-300m backbone, CNN feature extractor frozen, lower encoder layers frozen (default 8 layers), AttentiveStatisticalPooling layer calculating attention-weighted temporal mean and standard deviation (768 -> 1536), projection head (1536 -> 256 -> 64 -> 2) with LayerNorm and Dropout.

models.name: AcousticSpectralDetector (Safe Fallback)
models.architecture: Returns fixed neutral score 0.5 with UNCERTAIN verdict and explicit warning when neural weights fail to load.

algorithms: Polyphase FIR resampling via scipy.signal.resample and torchaudio.
Attentive Statistical Pooling (ASP) with Tanh attention scoring.
Focal Loss: FL(p_t) = -alpha_t * (1 - p_t)^gamma * log(p_t) with gamma=2.0, alpha=0.5.
Brent's root-finding method (scipy.optimize.brentq) to compute exact EER where FAR(tau) == FRR(tau).
Trapezoidal numerical integration for Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC) and Area Under Risk-Coverage (AURC).
training_pipeline: Loads dataset via DeepfakeAudioDataset with real-time acoustic distortion data augmentation (probability p=0.5).
AdamW optimizer with learning rate 2e-5, weight decay 1e-4, linear warmup, and early stopping on validation EER.
Computes validation metrics each epoch; checkpoints best_model_eer.pt and calibrates genuine/synthetic decision boundaries.
inference_pipeline: 6. Preprocess via Hugging Face AutoFeatureExtractor (zero-mean unit-variance normalization).
7. Execute model forward pass under torch.no_grad().
8. Apply softmax over logits; extract P(spoof).
9. Average chunk scores; apply genuine (<=0.35) and synthetic (>=0.65) decision thresholds.
data_sources: ASVspoof 2019 Logical Access (LA) and Deepfake (DF) corpora.
LibriSpeech ASR corpus (authentic clean human speech).
preprocessing: Sliding window chunking with chunk size = 4.0 seconds (64,000 samples).
feature_engineering: Self-supervised 768-dimensional latent representations extracted from wav2vec 2.0 transformer encoder.
Attentive Statistical Pooling (ASP) extracting temporal mean and standard deviation vectors across time frames.
evaluation_metrics: Equal Error Rate (EER): Threshold where False Acceptance Rate equals False Rejection Rate.
Area Under ROC Curve (ROC-AUC): Discrimination capability across all operational thresholds.
Type I Error (False Positive Rate / FPR): Human speech misclassified as synthetic.
Type II Error (False Negative Rate / FNR): Synthetic deepfake slipping past undetected.
Area Under the Risk-Coverage Curve (AURC): Selective prediction reliability under abstention.
95% Bootstrap Confidence Intervals: Percentile method over 1,000 resamples.
model_artifacts: Trained research checkpoint (optional): best_model_eer.pt configured via ECHOPROOF_CHECKPOINT.
confidence_scoring: Primary score is the softmax-normalized activation for the spoof class: P(spoof) in [0.0, 1.0].
Stability score standard deviation computed across 11 perturbation transforms.
fallback_mechanisms: AcousticSpectralDetector: If neural weights fail to load, model issues neutral score 0.5 and UNCERTAIN verdict.
limitations: Unseen generator vulnerability: Models tested on unseen synthesis models (e.g. FastSpeech 2 cross-lingual) can experience false negatives.
Channel sensitivity: G.722 telephony downsampling and low-bitrate MP3 compression increase EER by up to 20 percentage points.
reproducibility_requirements: Fixed random seeds (default seed 42) in dataset splitting, augmentation, and bootstrap evaluation.
Manifest CSV recording file paths, labels, and speaker identities.
Sample rate strictly locked to 16,000 Hz.

integrations.name: Hugging Face Hub
integrations.purpose: Retrieving pretrained weights and tokenizer/feature extractor configs for wav2vec2 models.
integrations.authentication_method: Optional HF_TOKEN for private models; unauthenticated for public MelodyMachine/Deepfake-audio-detection-V2.
request_flow: During lifespan startup, AutoModelForAudioClassification.from_pretrained queries Hugging Face Hub or reads local cache.
response_handling: Caches PyTorch model weights locally in user .cache/huggingface directory.
retry_and_failure_handling: If connection fails and no cached model exists, catches Exception, logs warning, and switches to AcousticSpectralDetector.
data_synced: Model state dict weights and configuration JSON.

integrations.name: FFmpeg CLI
integrations.purpose: Encoding audio to MP3 at specified bitrates and decoding back to measure codec resilience.
request_flow: AudioTransformer writes temporary WAV, executes ffmpeg -y -i input.wav -b:a 64k output.mp3, and reads back output.
response_handling: Decodes MP3 using SoundFile, resamples back to target sample rate.
retry_and_failure_handling: Catches FileNotFoundError when FFmpeg is not installed, falls back to simulated quantization noise.

integrations.name: Capacitor Mobile Runtime
integrations.purpose: Compiles the web frontend into a native Android application wrapper.
request_flow: npx cap copy copies frontend/dist to native Android asset directory.
response_handling: Native webview renders the application with cleartext enabled for local LAN backend access.

resolved_problems.issue: Hugging Face Alphabetical Label Inversion Bug
resolved_problems.description: Standard ASVspoof models map 0 to bonafide and 1 to spoof. Hugging Face AudioFolder sorted directory names alphabetically: 0: fake, 1: real. The detector initially assumed index 1 meant spoof, causing real human voice to score 0.999 (fake) and synthetic voice to score 0.001 (real).
resolved_problems.resolution: Implemented _find_spoof_index() and _find_bonafide_index() in Wav2Vec2Detector to inspect semantic label text dynamically. Added test_detector_mapping.py confirming correct class direction.

resolved_problems.description: Standard MediaRecorder recorded WebM/Opus audio. Certain browsers and soundfile backends failed to parse WebM container headers during file load.
resolved_problems.resolution: Wrote custom pcmToWav() function in AnalyzePage.tsx using ScriptProcessorNode to construct standard 16-bit PCM RIFF WAVE headers directly in the browser.

resolved_problems.description: The client-side demo button initially generated a 220 Hz mathematical sine wave beep and labeled it genuine voice. The neural network correctly classified the electronic tone as 100% artificial.
resolved_problems.resolution: Replaced the mathematical oscillator with genuine human speech recordings from LibriSpeech and LJSpeech in scratch_audio/ground_truth/.

resolved_problems.description: The repository previously lacked frontend/src/lib/types.ts and frontend/src/lib/api.ts, preventing the Vite build and causing blank pages on startup.
resolved_problems.resolution: Created type-safe types.ts mirroring Pydantic schemas and api.ts implementing fetch wrappers for all endpoints.

ai_handoff_instructions.project_context_summary: EchoProof AI is a full-stack speech deepfake detection research platform coupling a FastAPI backend, fine-tuned wav2vec 2.0 neural inference with attentive statistical pooling, an 11-condition acoustic robustness testing lab, leak-free speaker-disjoint dataset benchmarking, and a React 19 glassmorphic interface.
critical_facts: The default model MelodyMachine/Deepfake-audio-detection-V2 maps index 0 to 'fake' and index 1 to 'real'. Never assume index 1 is fake. The codebase dynamically queries model.config.id2label to identify classes.
The backend must never generate a 'Genuine' verdict from spectral heuristics when neural weights fail. It must abstain with an 'Uncertain' verdict and an explicit warning.
The sample clips in research/data/ are for testing and UI demonstration only. They must not be used to claim production accuracy or trained on as an ASVspoof replacement.
Target sample rate is strictly 16,000 Hz. AudioProcessor downmixes to mono and applies polyphase resampling.
Audio exceeding 4.0s duration is chunked into 4.0s windows and aggregated via arithmetic mean.
Evaluation requires disjoint speakers between validation and test splits to prevent biometric data leakage.
important_file_paths: backend/app/audio/processor.py (Audio ingestion, mono conversion, 16kHz resampling, chunking)
research/train.py (Model training script with Focal Loss & ASP)
research/benchmark.py (Research benchmark script generating LaTeX/Markdown tables)
architectural_invariants: Inference scores returned by detector.score() are always P(spoof) in [0.0, 1.0].
Decision boundary rule: P(spoof) <= THRESHOLD_GENUINE (0.35) -> LIKELY_GENUINE; P(spoof) >= THRESHOLD_SYNTHETIC (0.65) -> LIKELY_SYNTHETIC; otherwise UNCERTAIN.
Temporary upload files in backend/temp_audio/ must always be cleaned up in a finally block.
JobManager capacity must remain bounded to prevent memory leaks.
coding_conventions: Python: Use type annotations, Pydantic models for data schemas, and standard logging instead of raw print statements.
TypeScript: Strict typing; interfaces in frontend/src/lib/types.ts must stay synchronized with backend backend/app/schemas.py.
CSS: Use design tokens defined in frontend/src/index.css (e.g. var(--accent), var(--bg-card), var(--text-primary)).
constraints_for_future_changes: Do not hardcode class index mappings for audio classification models; always inspect label text strings.
Do not replace neutral model abstention with naive heuristic classification.
Do not remove speaker-disjoint splitting from the evaluation pipeline.
known_failure_patterns: Running uvicorn without virtual environment dependencies will fail with ModuleNotFoundError for soundfile or transformers.
Testing microphone recording on non-localhost/non-HTTPS origins in Chrome will fail due to WebRTC security policies.
recommended_first_actions_for_an_ai: 1. Verify both servers are running: check GET http://localhost:8000/api/v1/health and GET http://localhost:5173.
2. Run the pytest suite (cd backend && python -m pytest tests/) to ensure all 20 tests pass.
3. Verify that frontend/src/lib/types.ts and api.ts are intact before making frontend modifications.
questions_requiring_developer_input: What external storage backend (PostgreSQL, Redis, or S3) is preferred for multi-tenant production deployment?
Which specific GPU cluster or cloud provider will be used for training Wav2Vec2-XLS-R on the multi-terabyte SpeechFake corpus?
